title: Principal hues and positive emotional responses
statement:
Principal hues (red, yellow, green, blue) elicit significantly higher positive emotional responses than intermediate or achromatic hues.

Options:
- High Emotion / Energetic: Principal Hues (Pure RGB/Y) (fits: social media, kids apps)
- Neutral / Somber: Achromatic (Black/Grey) (fits: news, luxury)
- Complex / Muted: Intermediate Hues (fits: lifestyle brands, wellness)
appliesWhen: Applies to: consumer apps, marketing sites. Audience: general.
